_comment: Person gates for the LinkedIn arm. countries/cities anchor on the COMPANY's location (from our own OSM sourcing), never the person's profile location — a 'Dubai' profile at a Dubai company is fine, a 'Dubai' profile at a Paris company is not.
_accept_tiers_comment: T1 ONLY (user directive 2026-07-31: 'they should be the owners/CEOs of businesses'). T2 is heads-of and directors — senior, but employees, not the person who decides. Accepting T2 was letting a sales director into an owner-only campaign.
_school_boost_comment: Shared-university hook: David is at AUB, so a Lebanese-university alumnus now working in the Gulf can be opened on honestly ('we both came through AUB'). Nothing here filters WHO is contacted — it only ranks who is contacted first.
_title_tiers_comment: MERGED ON TOP of the built-in owner/CEO dictionary in qualify_people.py (chairman, CEO, founder, co-founder, owner, proprietor, partner, managing director/partner, president, general manager). These are the owner-equivalent titles the three sourced verticals actually use.
